scope: Exact named base-to-candidate publication paths, with explicit closure staging and cached-set verification
urlClassification: functional registry/package/schema/local app endpoints and supporting public documentation; no private session links
fixtureClassification: synthetic 1px PNG constructed in test code; timestamps and generated IDs are disposable test metadata
binaryReview: GLB contract forbids images/textures; normal Blender source/receipt check; native and Blender original/proxy pixels inspected
nativeOwnerDataRoot: Never opened; all native tests use the guarded disposable root.
failedRunRetention: Initial failed/interrupted aggregates, navigation investigations, native attempts and stale-lease startup remain separate; two unavailable temporary stdout receipts are documented honestly.
logNormalization: ANSI removal, private path substitution and trailing-whitespace normalization; semantic output retained.
